John Carmack spent some time in one of his famous keynotes talking about functional programming. On the one hand, obviously video games tend to be very stateful, and implementing them in imperative terms is natural. On the other hand, tons of specific things you do inside a game (or in any program) can be described as pure functions, and doing that is often a great idea.
